newsitem.title: USA: John McCain in line for US Senate Commerce chair.
newsitem.headline: John McCain in line for US Senate Commerce chair.

text.p: Arizona Republican John McCain is in line to become chairman of the Senate Commerce Committee next year following the defeat of Chairman Larry Pressler in Tuesday's elections.
"I assume Sen. McCain will be chairman," Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott said at a news conference. Pressler lost in South Dakota to Democratic Rep. Tim Johnson.

Ted Stevens of Alaska is next in seniority on the committee, but will become chairman of the Appropriations Committee. The Commerce Committee handles bills affecting telecommunications, aviation and other industries.
